description: Typed research evidence only; not an internet/credential access mechanism

entities.constraint: 1 <= dimension <= 6; exact rational matrix, discrete or continuous
Symmetric positive-definite P with exactly zero equation residual
Bounded integer grid; negative findings cannot establish universal stability
A one-step or instantaneous norm-growth witness is not an instability or blow-up proof
Digest detects accidental drift, not adversarial forgery or source authenticity

verification_contract: All quantities are exact rational fractions, not floating point approximations
Solver must recompute Lyapunov equations and all positive principal minors
Grid claims must disclose finite radius and checked-point count
Reject unrecognized input and never interpret INCONCLUSIVE as failure or stability
Never run credential discovery, key guessing, network probing or unauthorized external calls
Data about the physical world is not inferred merely from a symbolic model
